# Kalki Materials

> Kalki Materials is a curated architectural material distributor for Aruba, Bonaire and Curaçao (the ABC islands). It is the single supplier on the islands for four European manufacturers, supplying architects, interior designers and contractors (business to business only) with floor, wall, ceiling, terrace and pool surfaces, delivered all-in.

Kalki brings a Mediterranean material language to the Caribbean: whitewash-style limestone plaster, light oak, wood-look composite for exteriors and small-format porcelain for pools. Every product is chosen to hold up in salt air, UV and humidity. Kalki handles specification support, samples, consolidated freight from Europe, customs and delivery to site, with one island price and a delivery date planned around the project.

Kalki Materials is a brand of IDEA II B.V. Contact: Kalkimaterials@gmail.com.

## Material lines

- [FB Hout — engineered oak](https://www.kalkimaterials.com/FB%20Hout.dc.html): engineered European oak for floors, walls and ceilings (Netherlands). Oak wear layer on an exterior-grade (WBP) birch plywood core, full-surface glue-down, Hardwax oil finishes, plank widths from 75 mm to 300 mm, herringbone and chevron on request.
- [Mas Maya — limestone plaster](https://www.kalkimaterials.com/Mas%20Maya.dc.html): hand-applied lime-based plaster (Spain) forming one seamless surface across floors, walls, ceilings, wet rooms, façades and pools, without tile lines or grout. Breathable, flexible, water-resistant, zero VOC. Kalki can connect projects with trained applicators.
- [Tarimatec — exterior system](https://www.kalkimaterials.com/Tarimatec.dc.html): decking, ventilated façade cladding (Montblanc) and screens/louvres (Annapurna, Aris, Axel) in Ecofiber Stone Composite made from recovered rice husk, stone and PVC (Spain). No oiling or sanding; 5 Chromatic colours and 14 Wood tones; supplied as a complete system with clips and 316 stainless steel fixings.
- [Wow Design — porcelain](https://www.kalkimaterials.com/Wow%20Design.dc.html): small-format wellness porcelain for pools, terraces and bathrooms from a ceramic studio in Castellón, Spain. Collections Sukabumi, Marble and Aqua (matt, R11 / Class 3 non-slip, frost-resistant), plus Icon and Reef matt stoneware pieces for architectural features.
